title: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Eternal: card flavor text

entities.name: Donatello
entities.description: One of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, the brains of the team, given to scientific explanations.

entities.name: Leonardo
entities.description: One of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, a goody two-toes whom his brothers turn to when it is time to get serious.

entities.name: Raphael
entities.description: One of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, a tough fighter who uses shuriken.

entities.name: Michelangelo
entities.description: One of the Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, a fun-loving comic book fan.

entities.name: Splinter
entities.description: The Turtles' mentor, who calls them his sons and returns to the Battle Nexus every decade to honor an old friend.

entities.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles
entities.description: The team of mutant turtle brothers, the world's most fearsome fighting team.

entities.name: April O'Neil
aliases: April O'Neil, Live on the Scene
entities.description: A reporter who digs into stories so hot that people try to kill her.

entities.name: Irma Langenstein
entities.description: April's colleague who edits footage and claims trouble just follows her around.

entities.name: Krang
entities.description: A self-proclaimed all-powerful villain who designs weapons and creates monsters.

entities.name: Karai
entities.description: A warrior who claims to have already beaten one of the turtles.

entities.name: Rat King
entities.description: A villain who treats others as pawns on a chessboard.

entities.name: Tempestra
entities.description: A games-themed villain who raises the stakes to the fate of the world.

entities.name: Tokka
entities.description: A mutant that no prison could hold, who misses home and a friend.

entities.name: Rahzar
entities.description: A mutant paired with Tokka.

entities.name: Professor Jordan Perry
entities.description: A professor who describes Tokka and Rahzar as infants rather than stupid.

entities.name: Baxter
entities.description: A scientist turned into a freak who fears he will never be taken seriously again.

entities.name: Leatherhead
entities.description: A thousand-pound reptile with a punishing bite who warns of dangerous rivers.

entities.name: Bebop
entities.description: A mutant villain and partner of Rocksteady who traveled through time with a stolen Time Scepter.

entities.name: Rocksteady
entities.description: A mutant villain and partner of Bebop.

entities.name: Daimyo
entities.description: The host who welcomes travelers from many universes to the Battle Nexus Tournament.

entities.name: General Traag
entities.description: An officer who uses a weather-making device of Krang's design.

entities.name: Renet
entities.description: A time traveler tracking Bebop and Rocksteady through time with the Time Scepter.

entities.name: Ray Fillet
entities.description: A being whose preservation was made a spectacle, bitter at modern human society.

entities.name: Shredder
entities.description: Leader of the Foot, who claims to be father to its outcast members.

entities.name: Seri
entities.description: A Triceraton destined to be Regenta, seeking to avenge her mother's death.

entities.name: Casey Jones
entities.description: A hockey-themed vigilante who calls out penalties as he fights.

entities.name: Mona Lisa
entities.description: An adaptable character who enjoys a little chaos.

entities.name: Slash
entities.description: A creature considered too perfect a weapon for the Null Group to let rest in peace, copied into temperamental knockoffs.

entities.name: Antonio's
entities.description: An establishment that accommodated every request and stayed open late.

entities.name: Esposito
entities.description: A figure Splinter invokes as his liege of flavor.

entities.name: Wilcox
entities.description: Someone quoted by Donatello as saying a weed is an unloved flower.

entities.name: Null Group
entities.description: An organization that would not let Slash rest in peace and made knockoffs of him.

entities.name: Time Masters
entities.description: Those who make their home in the 79th dimension of Null-Time.

entities.name: Null-Time
entities.description: A realm of dimensions whose 79th dimension, home of the Time Masters, is the most stable.

entities.name: Triceraton Republic
entities.description: The survivors of a shattered homeworld who intend to make that everyone else's problem.

entities.name: The Foot
entities.description: Shredder's organization, presented as a family for those the outside world rejects.

entities.name: Utrom
entities.description: A peace-minded people, up to a point, beyond which they are laser-minded.

entities.name: Channel 6
entities.description: A news station that built its headquarters in the '80s.

entities.name: Intergalactic Wrestling Federation
entities.description: A wrestling federation based at Stump Arena.

entities.name: Stump Asteroid
entities.description: Home of Stump Arena and the Intergalactic Wrestling Federation.

entities.name: Planet Morbus
entities.description: A planet where interstellar civilizations dump unwanted elements, from toxins to lowlifes.

entities.name: Dimension X
entities.description: A strange dimension where every microhabitat flourishes, from planet-sized eyes to asteroid-top jungles.

entities.name: Prehistoric Earth
entities.description: Earth's distant past, where Bebop and Rocksteady traveled.

entities.name: Battle Nexus
entities.description: A tournament gathering fighters from diverse universes, to which Splinter returns every decade.

entities.name: Time Scepter
entities.description: A scepter that controls time and bends reality, letting its master rewrite history.

entities.name: New York
entities.description: The Turtles' city, whose residents have seen everything.

entities.name: Mutagen
entities.description: The substance that creates mutants.

events.summary: Seri declares she must fulfill her destiny as Triceraton Regenta and avenge her mother's death.
events.quote: I am meant to be the Triceraton Regenta, so I must fulfill my destiny and avenge my mother's death!

events.summary: The Null Group refuses to let Slash rest in peace and produces temperamental knockoffs of him.
events.quote: Slash was too perfect a weapon for the Null Group to let him rest in peace . . . Even if the knockoffs proved temperamental.

events.summary: Daimyo welcomes travelers from many universes to the Battle Nexus Tournament.
events.quote: You have traveled from the multitude of diverse universes, and I bid you welcome to the Battle Nexus Tournament.

events.summary: Using a stolen Time Scepter, Bebop and Rocksteady depart for Prehistoric Earth.
events.quote: Using their stolen Time Scepter—with total command of time and space—Bebop and Rocksteady departed for Prehistoric Earth

events.summary: Renet tracks Bebop and Rocksteady to the Caribbean in 1530 with the Time Scepter.
events.quote: the Time Scepter says Bebop and Rocksteady should be here somewhere.

events.summary: Shredder tells outcasts that the Foot is their family and he is their father.
events.quote: The Foot is your family. I am your father.

events.summary: Splinter returns to the Battle Nexus once every decade to fight in honor of an old friend.
events.quote: Once every decade, Splinter returns to the Battle Nexus. He fights not for glory, but to honor an old friend.

relations.note: Splinter teaches the Turtles, calling them his sons.
relations.quote: One need not always find peace on the sword's edge, my son.
Bebop and Rocksteady departed for Prehistoric Earth in search of "somethin' big ta wrassle."
The Foot is your family. I am your father.
The 79th dimension of Null-Time—the one the Time Masters call home—is the most stable.

relations.note: Bebop and Rocksteady stole the Time Scepter.
They would not let Slash rest in peace and made knockoffs.
relations.quote: Slash was too perfect a weapon for the Null Group to let him rest in peace
April, how am I supposed to edit all of this footage into something watchable, much less believable?

relations.note: Stump Asteroid is home of the federation.
relations.quote: Stump Asteroid: Home of Stump Arena and the Intergalactic Wrestling Federation!

relations.note: Renet is tracking Bebop and Rocksteady through time.
relations.quote: the Time Scepter says Bebop and Rocksteady should be here somewhere.
he was also the one they turned to when it was time to put the jokes away.
